items.name: Bruschetta al Pomodoro
items.description: Toasted sourdough topped with vine-ripened tomatoes, fresh basil, garlic, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

items.name: Arancini di Riso
items.description: Golden fried risotto balls filled with mozzarella and ragù, served with a rich tomato dipping sauce.

items.name: Grilled Sea Bass
items.description: Fresh Atlantic sea bass grilled to perfection, served with lemon butter sauce, capers, and roasted vegetables.

items.name: Osso Buco alla Milanese
items.description: Braised veal shanks slow-cooked in white wine and broth, served with saffron risotto and gremolata.

items.name: Tagliatelle al Tartufo
items.description: Hand-rolled egg tagliatelle tossed in a rich truffle cream sauce with Parmigiano Reggiano and fresh black truffle.

items.name: Spaghetti alle Vongole
items.description: Classic spaghetti with fresh Manila clams in a white wine, garlic, and parsley sauce.

items.name: Tiramisu Classico
items.description: The classic Italian dessert — layers of espresso-soaked ladyfingers and silky mascarpone cream, dusted with premium cocoa.

items.name: Panna Cotta ai Frutti di Bosco
items.description: Silky vanilla panna cotta topped with a vibrant mixed berry compote and fresh mint.

items.name: Aperol Spritz
items.description: The iconic Italian aperitif — Aperol, Prosecco, and soda water over ice with a fresh orange slice.

items.name: Virgin Citrus Cooler
items.description: A refreshing blend of freshly squeezed lemon, lime, orange juice, and sparkling water with mint.
